name: Audit CRM data hygiene and nudge each deal owner in Slack
description: Every Monday an AI agent reads open Salesforce opportunities, checks them against the required fields you define per stage and flags missing fields, past-due close dates, deals with no recent activity and contradictory records. It drafts one Slack message per opportunity owner. A person reviews the issues table and the drafts, and only approved messages are sent.
shortDescription: Find incomplete and stale deals, then nudge each owner once in Slack after approval.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the crm-hygiene-audit skill, a Salesforce SOQL tool and the Slack Find User by Email tool
Stage rules and the staleness threshold kept in the system prompt, easy to change
One batched Slack nudge per owner, never one per record
Approval step before any message is posted; CRM records are never edited
prerequisites: The `crm-hygiene-audit` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
Salesforce connection with read access to Opportunity and User
Slack connection that can send direct messages and has the users:read.email scope
Your required fields per pipeline stage, written into the AI Agent's system prompt
idealFor: RevOps teams that want a clean pipeline before every forecast or pipeline review.
steps: Audit the pipeline: the AI Agent loads the crm-hygiene-audit skill, queries open opportunities with SOQL, flags issues and resolves each owner to a Slack user by email.
Approve nudges: the run pauses until a reviewer approves the issues table and the drafted messages.
Approved: send one Slack direct message per owner and log a summary.
Rejected: log the reviewer's comment and send nothing.
